notes: Sepolia test faucet. TokenFaucet features DRIP, starts without tokens and requires no initialization. There is no owner, admin or withdrawal path. Donations are final. Anyone can claim through multiple addresses; this is not a fair or valuable distribution. Each token's balance, decimals and transfer behavior is trusted for its own pool. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; services determine the effective opening price from the pinned policy when applicable.
